title: Supporting vocabulary for context
description: Practical words used to make the new example sentences clear and natural.

cards.english: Go over there; the past (in context)
Sound as if; appear from hearing
Know how to; will; be likely to
Turn off a phone or computer
Organization; work unit; unit of measure
Suddenly understand; get the hang of it
just at (that time); right in (that place); right in the middle of (doing sth)
graduation; to graduate; to finish school
at last; in the end; finally
to ask; to invite; please (do sth)
